programmes.programName: Ph.D. program in Information, Risk, and Operations Management
programmes.department: Department of Information, Risk, and Operations Management
programmes.evidence: Official current IROM PhD has four study areas including OM and DecisionSciences. OM research explicitly covers supply chains, manufacturing, services, revenue and project management with analytical/empirical models; department programme inventory establishes concentration and host mapping.
limitations: Four areas in one doctoral programme, not separate counted degrees; decision science includes finance/risk methods and not wholly operations.

limitations: No separate ORIE administrative department established; programme hosted by actual school.
